units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 28b:5">M. Kat. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>ויי לאזלא ויי לח׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>לחִבּוּלָא</he>) woe for him that is gone, woe for the loss!—
<cite ref="Bekhorot 8b:20">Bekh. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>מנא דלא שוי חֲבִילֵיה</he> (Rashi <he>חבליה</he>) a utensil which is not worth the damage which it causes.
